subject.title: feat(agents): report per-run stats (code-mode engagement, round trips, cost) in agent JSON envelopes

question: Should the new public per-run telemetry guarantee aggregation across model retries and provider fallbacks before this JSON contract is introduced?
rationale: The documented meaning is run-wide, while the patch currently ties bridge counts and pricing to the final attempt/model; maintainers should confirm the intended semantics before a repair is landed.

options.title: Make all fields run-wide
options.body: Accumulate bridge counters and per-attempt costs so the envelope matches its documented per-run semantics.

options.title: Expose final-attempt semantics
options.body: Rename and document the affected fields as final-attempt statistics, accepting that they no longer describe the whole run.

recommendation.title: Make all fields run-wide
recommendation.body: Accumulate bridge counters and per-attempt costs so the envelope matches its documented per-run semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This author supplied the current implementation and its documented telemetry semantics; broader current-main ownership history was unavailable to inspect.
